distribution: Mount Mang, Yizhang, Hunan (altitude about 500 m).
soldier: Head, labrum, antennae and pronotum of the soldier yellow; posterior part of the head and posterior half of the pronotum paler; mandibles brown with a reddish tinge; thorax and abdomen pale yellowish white. Head sparsely beset with setae; apical setae and lateral apical setae of the labrum prominent; setae on the tergites of the thorax and abdomen rather numerous. Head shaped like an elongated trapezoid combined with an oval, widest posteriorly near the turn of the two posterior lateral margins; frons flat or slightly raised, not elevated above the dorsal surface of the occiput; fontanelle situated in the depression behind the frontal peaks, appearing as a small brown dot. Labrum ligulate, transparent area absent or very short, apex rounded and blunt. Mandibles rather slender and straight; left mandible 0.85–0.93 times the greatest head width, apex slightly curved. Antennae 15–17 segments, the fourth the shortest. Anterior margin of the pronotum with a rather broad and deep incision in the middle, posterior margin with a shallower incision.
taxonomy_note: The species was placed in Tsaitermes in the original work; it is here placed in Reticulitermes.
